sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm at the aquarium to see the penguins feed.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'd like to hear about them before feeding time.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I try to open the guide by the entrance.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, is the audio guide included with my ticket?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, you can play it on your phone.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Good, I've got my headphones with me.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Just open the guide in your browser and choose English.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I think I've opened the wrong page.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's the ticket page you've got open there.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Where can I find the link to the guide?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Scan the code on the sign next to the kiosk.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I scan the code and show him the new page.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: It says I can listen offline if I download it.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's right, and you'll need that for the penguin room.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: My phone's got a good signal here by the door.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: There's Wi-Fi down there by the stairs, but it doesn't reach the penguins.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, where does the Wi-Fi stop working?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: There's no Wi-Fi in the penguin room.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Then I'll download the guide before I go down.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Tap Download Audio and wait for the little green tick.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: It's done, but how do I find the penguin part?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Tap stop four, with the picture of a penguin.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I put my headphones in and try stop four.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I can hear it, but the volume's a little low.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Turn it up a bit with the button on your phone.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: That's better, but some words are still hard to catch.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: You can read the transcript right under the play button.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I save it to read later?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, take a screenshot while you've still got a signal.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I've got the words and the audio now.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I listen by the penguin pool before the feeding starts.
